atoms.text: On February 18, 2021, the Perseverance rover landed on Mars. This was a very successful day for NASA because they had planned this mission for a long time. The purpose of the mission was to answer the question: was there ever life on Mars?

The Perseverance rover is as big as a car and is packed with a lot of scientific instruments to further explore Mars. Perseverance even has a small helicopter included with it. This allowed scientist to run flight experiments on a planet other than Earth for the first time. With this mission, scientists hoped to learn more about Mars and if the planet was ever capable of supporting life.
